title: ESMO 2026: Merck, Moderna shares fall as cancer vaccine disappoints after data leak
snippet: A combination of the personalized cancer vaccine intismeran autogene and Merck's Keytruda just barely cleared analysts’ expectations for recurrence-free survival, leaving questions as to its applicability to tumor types beyond melanoma.

title: AbbVie’s skin disease drug lessens abscess burden in Phase 3 but falls below expectations
snippet: AbbVie is eyeing regulatory filings in 2027 for the skin disease drug lutikizumab after clearing multiple endpoints in a late-stage trial, but the results have disappointed some analysts, raising questions about its commercial prospects.
